topic: Order sensitivity of a local code judge
claim: Swapping presentation order may change a judge decision; stable decisions may still be wrong.
experiment: Eight executable authored code pairs, both A/B orders, two installed local models; eight tie controls per model.
baseline: Canonical presentation of the identical code strings, paired with reversed presentation.
metrics: Correct judgments/16, paired consistency/8, changed choices/8, consistently wrong/8, correct ties/8 per model.
data: Authored contracts/implementations, executable tests, no downloaded candidate code.
resources: 48 sequential local generations; INVARIANT/current Codex for scorer implementation and validation.
runtime: Approximately 10–30 minutes depending on local inference.
limitations: Single seed, tiny simple coding sample, older quantized models; no human preference or population bias claim.
classification: New local diagnostic, not MT-Bench reproduction; no code-repair agent feedback as in earlier experiment.

claim: Shared environment control changes the security evaluation setting.
experiment: Would require an owned multi-turn stateful environment with validated attack and benign controls.
baseline: Static-user environment versus controlled user state changes.
metrics: Task success, policy violation and false rejection by scenario.
data: Paper abstract checked; executable scenarios and full methodology not audited today.
resources: Local adaptation possible, faithful 14-model study exceeds installed model set.
limitations: Cannot validate conference-acceptance news from the abstract; no external attacks; overlaps yesterday if reduced to a single stale-write race.
classification: Deferred rather than claiming a faithful replication.

topic: Memory compaction and retention of constraints
claim: Agent memory representation and reorganization can affect which prior constraints remain available.
experiment: Paired authored transcripts and frozen compacted representations with independently scored obligations.
baseline: Full transcript versus fixed memory representation.
metrics: Constraint retrieval and task correctness, prompt tokens.
data: Guide introduction and memory hierarchy inspected; would need balanced transcripts and compaction controls.
resources: Installed local models, no API spend.
limitations: Not a reproduction of vendor memory evaluations; risks confounding omission with inference errors.
classification: Deferred; judge diagnostic has a more direct execution oracle today.
